quote: Its methylation degrades Lax1 and Tipe2 to promote follicular B cells, while with METTL3, it supports YTHDF2-dependent IL-7-induced pro-B differentiation ( 89 ).
summary: A review of m6A in autoimmunity mentions in passing that m6A methylation degrades Lax1 to promote follicular B cells; nothing specific to UC.

quote: Although the 66 shared genes were detectable across all eight cell types, they segregated into distinct cell-type–biased modules, with a prominent plasma/B-cell program (e.g., IGKC, MZB1, CD38, FCRL5, CD79A ) and an innate inflammatory myeloid program centered on IL1B (e.g., IL1B, NCF4, CTSH, FCGR2B/FCGR3B, LAX1 ), alongside epithelial ( EPCAM, KRT19 ) and endothelial ( PECAM1, ICAM2, SELE ) signatures ( Figure 3E ).
summary: LAX1 is listed among 66 genes shared between periodontitis and IBD in a myeloid inflammatory module, with no gene-specific result.

quote: LAX1 is also the mapped gene for one of the top-ranked at-birth DMRs (Šidák-corrected p value: 7.2 × 10 −8 ) spanning six CpGs including cg12022621 (crude p value: 3 × 10 −4 , Table 4 ) and was identified only in the winter-born group of the higher latitude subset in the at-birth samples.
summary: A birth-season DNA methylation study maps a top differentially methylated region to LAX1; the paper concerns season of birth and schizophrenia, not UC.

quote: We identified 46 novel loci shared between JIA and various AIDs: 17 with AITD, 16 with RA, 13 with IBD, five each with MS and Ps, four with SLE, and seven with T1D.
summary: LAX1 is named only in a list of notable shared risk genes between juvenile idiopathic arthritis and other autoimmune diseases, with no IBD-specific result for it.

quote: The seven core genes (C2, IFITM3, FXYD3, LAX1, CD63, CKAP4, and SPPL2A) identified by Lasso regression achieved a minimum single-gene diagnostic AUC of ≥ 0.79 in the training cohort, showing robust diagnostic and predictive performance.
summary: LAX1 is one of seven Lasso-selected genes in a Crohn's disease diagnostic model that performed well in external cohorts; no gene-specific mechanism was tested.

quote: The lead variants for the other two genes were in high LD with rs10936744 ( rs34457525 for CEP97 and rs11714278 for NXPE3 , R 2 > 0.97), suggesting that a single eQTL signal likely affects the expression of all three genes.
summary: A COVID-19 susceptibility GWAS locus colocalizes with an esophageal eQTL for NXPE3; unrelated to UC.

summary: NXPE3 is listed among shared IBD and EAE differentially expressed genes that were not myeloid-enriched, with no gene-specific result.

quote: Co-localization analysis identified eight shared loci in TYK2, IKZF3, COL11A2, PSORS1C1, MANEAL and COG6 genes for COVID-19 with RA, and four in CRHR1, FUT2 and NXPE3 genes for COVID-19 with SLE.
summary: NXPE3 is a colocalized shared locus between COVID-19 and SLE; no UC or IBD finding.

summary: NXPE3 appears only in a list of 14 SARS-CoV-2-linked genes in a COVID-19 and head and neck cancer Mendelian randomization study; unrelated to UC.

quote: The GJA7 gene had decreased expression in the microarray analysis (fold change -1.39) and increased expression in the qRT-PCR analysis (fold change 3.08).
summary: In Caco-2 cells treated with a probiotic, GJA7 (GJC1) expression changed inconsistently between microarray and qRT-PCR; no barrier role for this gene was shown.

quote: Within the intestine, the range of connexins includes the following: Cx26, Cx32, Cx36, Cx37, Cx43, and Cx45 (Wang and Daniel, 2001 ; Kanczuga-Koda et al., 2004 ; Morita et al., 2004 ; Clair et al., 2008 ; Ezumi et al., 2008 ; Frinchi et al., 2013 ).
summary: A review of connexins, pannexins and purinergic signaling in gut inflammation notes Cx45 is expressed in the intestine, but focuses on Cx43.

quote: The downregulated DEGs shared between both subtypes were notable for numerous serine protease inhibitor genes ( SERPINEA1 , -A3 , -A5 ; -B3 , -B7 ) and gap junction genes GJA1 and GJC1 .
summary: GJC1 is noted as downregulated in both molecular subtypes of Crohn's disease patient-derived organoids, without further gene-specific analysis.

quote: Cx45 is also localized in the sinoatrial node [ 6 ], and Cx30.2 in the conduction system [ 7 ].
summary: A cardiac Cx43 review only mentions Cx45 localization in the heart conduction system; nothing about UC.

quote: Using the Affymetrix expression profile chip analysis, this study found that, in patients with UC, the expression levels of Cx43 and Cx45 were significantly increased, while Cx26 and Cx32 decreased.
summary: Cx45 (GJC1) expression was significantly increased in UC colon tissue versus controls by expression chip, with the paper's focus on Cx43.

quote: The atrioventricular nodes and the sinus are characterized by Cx45 and Cx31.9 and have a low velocity [ 137 ].
summary: A histology overview mentions Cx45 in cardiac nodes; unrelated to UC.

quote: Novel candidate colorectal cancer biomarkers identified by methylation microarray-based scanning.
summary: GJC1 hypermethylation was among ten methylation events that significantly distinguished colorectal cancers from normal mucosa; a cancer biomarker, not UC.

quote: RNA-seq Reveals Transcriptomic Differences in Inflamed and Noninflamed Intestinal Mucosa of Crohn's Disease Patients Compared with Normal Mucosa of Healthy Controls.
summary: GJC1 is listed among 19 significantly upregulated genes in Crohn's disease mucosa by RNA-seq; follow-up focused on CXCL1.

quote: Jejunal gene expression of multiple gut integrity factors were higher (P < 0.05) in the HWE as compared to the LWE lines, including claudin 22 (CLDN22), -34, occluding (OCDN), zona-occludin-2 (ZO-2), gap junction alpha1 (GJA1), GJA3, GJC1, and cadherin 1 (CDH1).
summary: GJC1 is listed among junction genes higher in water-efficient broiler lines; a chicken heat-stress study unrelated to UC.

quote: The most upregulated genes (log2FC > 2) among the 45 non-pseudogenes were NPSR1 , CCNO , CLDN2 , and C2CD4B .
summary: CCNO was among the most upregulated genes (log2FC above 2) in UC mucosal RNA-seq relative to controls.

quote: These results indicated that Ccno may play an important role in SLC6A14-mediated IL-1β secretion.
summary: Ccno (cyclin O) expression fell in inflammatory macrophages and was restored by SLC6A14 blockade, suggesting a role in IL-1β secretion; Ccno itself was not perturbed.

quote: In total, 9 MCI signatures ( IL1B , IL8 , IL6 , PTGS2 , IL1A , CCL2 , TNF , CXCL3 , and CXCL1 ) and 12 MC signatures ( CXCL11 , CXCL10 , CXCL9 , TNFSF10 , HLA-DQA1 , FCN1 , IGFBP4 , HLA-DPB1 , HLA-DQB1 , FAM26F , RGL1 , and CD4 ) were obtained and subsequently used to calculate a signature score for each monocyte in the scRNA-seq data sets of patients.
summary: FAM26F (CALHM6) is one of 12 genes in a trained-immunity monocyte signature scored in patient single-cell data, with no gene-specific result.

quote: CALHM6 is implicated in immune response modulation; the lead SNP (rs2637678, P=1.27×10-17; OR, 0.51; 95% CI, 0.44 to 0.60) exhibits strong expression quantitative trait loci effects, the risk allele being associated with lower lymphocytic expression of CALHM6.
summary: In a nephrotic syndrome GWAS, the CALHM6 locus risk allele is linked to lower lymphocyte CALHM6 expression, implying a protective immune role; not UC.

quote: SNP rs2858829 lies in an intergenic region and is a strong cis-eQTL for FAM26F gene, a gene that is shown to be selectively upregulated in UC colonic mucosa with active inflammation.
summary: A UC GWAS identified the 6q22.1 locus (rs2858829) as a cis-eQTL for FAM26F (CALHM6), which is upregulated in inflamed UC mucosa; no effect direction was stated.

quote: In that analysis, 6 gene-traits pairs are driven by gene expression in NK cells specifically; CD226 expression modifies systemic lupus erythematosus and primary biliary cirrhosis risk, TMEM163 expression modifies primary biliary cirrhosis risk, CALHM6 expression modifies ulcerative colitis risk, and both ZMIZ1 and OSM modify Crohn’s disease risk.
summary: An NK-cell transcriptome-wide association study links CALHM6 expression in NK cells to ulcerative colitis risk, with no direction given in the text.
